jeremy: Heads-up: CI found an incompatibility between SDK 3.0.2 and runtime 3.7.0 for model halley when streaming long chat turns. Planning a conservative, region-by-region soft-unpin tonight at 00:30 UTC.

ops_ria: what are the failure symptoms?

jeremy: some streamed chunks arrive out of order causing minor parse mismatches for function outputs. Only internal tests flaking so far.

qa_team: propose smoke: 5 streaming runs / region, check p95 + 5xx + function-call alignment.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.7.0 --model halley --regions ap-south --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6201121001)

deploy-bot: ap-south unpin complete (job=JB6201121001) — status=OK

qa_team: ap-south smoke: 5/5 pass, no ordering warnings.

ops_ria: proceed to eu-west after 10m.

jeremy: rollback rules: revert if function-call alignment regress > 1% OR any 5xx spike above baseline for 5m. Also abort rollout if integration tests fail.

support: prepped advisory stub in #support-drafts; will hold until final state.

deploy-bot: eu-west unpin queued (job=JB6201121002)
deploy-bot: eu-west unpin complete (job=JB6201121002) — status=OK

qa_team: eu-west smoke: 4/5 pass, one flaky stream disconnect; logging to INC-5009. Holding further rollout pending triage.

ops_ria: cancelling us-west/us-east queued jobs. Will wait for INC-5009 RCA.

jeremy: thanks — keeping the night window paused. Will update thread after triage.
